title: Three Weeks and One Short Envelope
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：telephone　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 telephone 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the postman ① used the telephone that no sender in the office would have noted, and he said the using was the whole of the week. The ② telephone, meaning the device itself and not the envelope, ran three weeks and stayed unnoted in the book; a telephone, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ telephone in that office had the same short envelope beside it, and the ④ telephone at the far box, meaning the parcel they kept for the children to fetch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A telephone, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the postman said the noting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the telephone was the whole of the matter, meaning the contact and not the device. The ⑥ telephone, meaning the contact and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; telephone, he said, is either something you use or the only word that means both a device and a contact. He said the contact is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ telephone had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short envelope. The ⑧ telephone of the whole thing, the postman wrote in June, was one office and three weeks of noting; telephone, he said, is either the parcel at the far box or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ telephone I remember is the device noted in the list, which closed in 1967 and is still noted as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ telephone, my mother said in 1969, is the only device that improves by being noted; every telephone, she said, is a contact that has agreed to look like a device. She said the contact was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 电话（指邮局里每一部旁边的那一部）
B. n. 电话（指那部电话本身，与薄薄的信封相对）
C. 固定搭配：use the telephone 打这一部电话
D. n. 电话（指留给孩子们取的那一件）
E. n. 电话之事（抽象总称，指一处邮局的电话之事）
F. n. 电话（指收发清单里写到、被记下的那一部）
G. n. 电话、联络（指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 联络（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: used the telephone that no sender in the office would have noted
The telephone, meaning the device itself and not the envelope
the telephone at the far box
the telephone was the whole of the matter
the telephone had become a line in a list
The telephone of the whole thing
A telephone, my mother said in 1969

answers.why: use the telephone 意为“打这一部电话”，1960 年那位邮差把邮局里没有一位寄信人肯记下的一部电话做了一遍。
telephone 意为“电话”，指那部电话本身而不是薄薄的信封，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记下。
telephone 意为“电话”，指邮局里每一部旁边的那一部，每一部旁边都有同一个薄薄的信封。
telephone 意为“电话”，指最远那只信箱的留给孩子们取的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
telephone 意为“电话、联络”，指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这部联络就是那件事的全部。
telephone 意为“联络”，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西而不是那部电话，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
telephone 意为“电话”，指收发清单里写到、被记下的那一部，到 1965 年这一部成了收发清单里的一行。
telephone 意为“电话之事”，邮差六月写道，整件事的电话之事是一处邮局和三个星期的记下。
telephone 意为“电话”，我记得的是收发清单里记下过的那一部，1967 年送完了，至今仍被说成邮局里最安静的一部。
telephone 为抽象总称，母亲 1969 年说，电话是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的电话。
